status.en: 15 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 56% fewer than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Golan Heights.
status.nb: 15 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 56 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Golanhøydene.

summary.en: Syria is now providing military advice and training to Saudi Arabia against Houthi attacks and has signed a defence cooperation deal that includes $403 million in loans. Israeli forces have intensified cross-border actions, reporting over 60 violations in Syria since November 1 and shelling sites in Quneitra as well as striking targets in Syria and Lebanon. Syrian authorities condemned attacks on security personnel in Amman and on Egyptian border guards, and a 55‑year-old man was killed by an unexploded ordnance explosion in Hama. The conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Syria gir nå militær rådgivning og trening til Saudi-Arabia mot houthiene og har signert en forsvarssamarbeidsavtale som inkluderer lån på 403 millioner dollar. Israelske styrker har intensivert grenseoverskridende handlinger, og rapporterer over 60 brudd i Syria siden 1. november, samt har skutt på mål i Quneitra og angrepet mål i Syria og Libanon. Syriske myndigheter fordømte angrep på sikkerhetspersonell i Amman og på egyptiske grensevakter, og en 55‑år gammel mann ble drept av en udetonert eksplosiv i Hama. Konflikten forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
